messages.author: 3eab71733027a24a
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Cannot install
parts:
which version of R is it using ? you say 4.0.3 but msg says 3.6.0 ?

I would guess at after install you may have to install another binary on
the RStudio server, see attached and chose Alternative 2 or 3.

On Wed, 2021-05-19 at 19:02 -0700, martin wall wrote:
> I used INLA on Rstudio desktop without (many) problems but now my
> organisation has switched to RStudio server
>
> When I now try to install INLA using
>
> install.packages("INLA",repos=c(getOption("repos"),INLA="https://inla.r-inla-download.org/R/stable
> "), dep=TRUE)
>
> I get 
> "Warning in install.packages : package ‘INLA’ is not available for
> this version of R"
> When I use R 4.0.3
> "Warning in install.packages : package ‘INLA’ is not available (for R
> version 3.6.3)" and 
> "Warning in install.packages : package ‘INLA’ is not available (for R
> version 3.6.0)"
>
> Are these error messages correct? 
>
> Martin
>

messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Cannot install
parts:
Maybe you can do a manual install and do

R CMD INSTALL ....

and download the package from

https://inla.r-inla-download.org/R/testing/src/contrib/INLA_21.05.02.tar.gz
